# C82
**The Moving Ceiling: adversary informational capability grows against fixed archives: the linkage corpus and side priors accumulate along calendar time, shrinking H(X \ | B_t) while nothing is added to the archive and no action of the subject is involved; R_inf(t) drifts upward on a schedule and every static reconstruction guarantee has a finite shelf life t*. Frontier-model releases enter only informationally (better extraction of linkage from existing corpora), never as compute against the information-theoretic guarantee, which is compute-saturated. (Re-worded by First-Person ruling 2026-07-17, ledger L149; erosion form proven conditional in WP-07 Def 3.9 + Cor 5.4b, L145; the conjectural content is the RATE. Pre-ruling wording, retired: "frontier capability growth raises C_S(t) + C_M(t)".)**

*Confidence:* ~65% · *Status:* active · registered Run 1, 2026-06-10 · re-typed 2026-07-17 · *Register:* core
*Home:* privacy_value_v6_draft.md Part I §I.3; research/pvm-v6-soil-and-the-programme-runtime-evolutions.md
